title: Geologic map of the Bennetts Point quadrangle, Charleston and Colleton Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2003, Geologic map of the Bennetts Point quadrangle, Charleston and Colleton Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-19, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face garbled. Symbols QHsm, QHs, QPsbs inferred from placement; 'QHiw' read as QHfw, '@Psbe' as QPsbe, three '|' thicknesses read as 1 (OCR rule, review). Point bar and Princess Anne symbols garbled. Legend-only items (contact, drill holes) not recorded. No water-quality or rock-test tables on the sheet.
SUBSURFACE: section A-A' (p.1) with FEET (40 to -70) and METERS scales, SEA LEVEL datum, vertical exaggeration 100; only the QPps label is legible on it; end locations and unit positions not legible. Terrace-sediment margin elevations stored as contacts (Holocene <10; Silver Bluff >6/<10; Princess Anne >12/<18; Pamlico >17/<25 ft; Port Royal terrace landward). Miocene lower contact not drilled. Map vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 5 feet; base map 1960). SCGS drill-hole logs on file at SCGS, not included.
